title: potentilla anemonifolia var. kleiniana
intro:
Potentilla anemonifolia var. kleiniana, commonly known as Dwarf Five-Leafed Potentilla or Korean Dwarf Cinquefoil, is a flowering plant native to East Asia, characterized by its low-growing habit and clusters of small, pink or white flowers.

This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla anemonifolia var. kleiniana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which work together to provide its medicinal properties.
